scope: Add the complete conditional OpenAI main statement with four defined analytic inputs, alongside the existing stronger variant and square obstruction. Short docstrings; detailed source correspondence in FClikelean/README.md and the human HTML.

source.title: Simultaneous primitive roots: a conditional lower bound for prime bases

formalization_choices: Finite-order Hecke characters represented by ray class characters. Continuation existence is required. Nonprincipal characters include regularity and nonvanishing at s=1; only the principal pole is excluded. Classical equivalence to the idele formulation and harmless imprimitive Euler factors has not been newly proved in Lean.

Input 4.1(i) uses a family of coefficients with common cancellation constants and thresholds. K is selected after the fixed family and before the band exponents. Both parts of Input 4.1 are present; the rough difference in (4.11) uses the density of (4.7).

Finite sieve objects are indexed by natural numbers. Squarefree products of designated primes are indexed by subsets; the empty subset includes the remainder at 1. Multiplicative g on squarefree products and R are defined from prime values and the actual weight.
Rough density is the explicit sum of the integrals in (4.7); input52 states both assertions in (5.3).

checks: Nonprincipal Hecke characters require nonvanishing at s=1
Empty designated sieve set still includes the absolute remainder at 1
All four input definitions depend only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound
